name: End card
description: The closing card: a logo, a title, the install command in a code chip and the URL, centred. Hold it 2–3 s at the end.
author: Biliup

logo.description: An image media item (PNG or SVG) shown on top.

title.description: One line under the logo. Markup: [[accent]], **bold**.

code.description: A command in a mono chip, e.g. npx your-tool init.

background.description: Fills the box (a theme token or CSS colour); leave it out to show what's under the card.
